text_block_list.text:
--One rest day. 
Tonight I'd come to the amusement park with Duramente. 
To enjoy the Halloween event!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The whole park is Halloween from end to end. 
Everyone's in costume, having a fine time.

Last Halloween she'd seemed to enjoy herself. 
So I thought she might be interested in the park's Halloween 
event too, and when I asked, she agreed at once.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's terribly crowded. In case we're separated, 
let's decide on a place to meet.
choice_data_list: Then let's keep in touch by phone--

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No... hmm... the signal may not get through. 
So let's meet in the entrance hall of the largest mansion, 
at the very back of the Ghost Town area.

The ghost parade has started! 
Ghosts roam all over the park, 
going around startling the guests.

text_block_list.name: Werewolf
text_block_list.text: Rrrooooooooh!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer, a pack of werewolves is coming! 
Sweets--apparently they'll leave if you give them sweets.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There's a candy wagon over there. 
Let's buy some!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Trainer is paying. 
Right--time to slip away before I'm noticed.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must finish my preparations 
before Trainer reaches the meeting place.

"If you've no plans on your rest day, 
it's Halloween--shall we go to the amusement park?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Decorating the trainer's office head to toe in Halloween, 
and in the end even inviting me to the amusement park.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(It seems Trainer wants 
to enjoy Halloween to the fullest.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The heart of Halloween is the trick. 
I must answer Trainer with a trick of my own.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...First, let me find a place to hide. 
The key is not letting them catch on, wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(From here I can see the hallway through the gap in the door. 
This should do nicely for hiding.)

(...Clatter) 
"Ahahahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...A-A doll, is it. 
D-Don't mind it... focus...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(When Trainer arrives, I spring the trick. 
For now, focus on that alone...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Just as I was taught. Use the mood of the place, 
don't let them catch on, and become Dracula--)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! --Here they come!

Separated from Duramente, I made my way to the entrance hall 
where we'd agreed to meet. But there was no sign of her at all, 
so I decided to search the hallway too.

The dim hallway is eerily silent. 
I open the door of a nearby room and look inside--

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Trick or trick.

A cold hand brushed the back of my neck. 
At the same moment, something clicked.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A baptism of trickery 
for the pitiful human who has entered my domain.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That choker is my mark. 
From this moment, you are my familiar.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I was called that once, long ago, was I? 
But I am your master now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Two choices are permitted to you. 
Will you become my kin? Or will you 
offer yourself up to me? Now, choose.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... My kin, then. 
Very well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let us live out eternity together.
choice_data_list: I swear to live out eternity

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you needn't swear it. 
--I have no intention of letting you go, you see.

Duramente smiles, bewitching. 
I catch myself staring-- 
and she pokes me on the forehead.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Then serve me well from here on, as my kin. 
Do not stray from me. Stay close.
choice_data_list: Of course, I always intended to!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You really... are a trainer through and through. 
--Ah, you've got me doing it too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Then--I shall have your blood.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. It is a vampire's meal, after all. 
Now, offer it up yourself. That red blood of yours--

Duramente smiles, bewitching. 
I catch myself staring-- 
and she pokes me on the forehead.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
From this moment your blood is mine. 
Keep it delicious, as a meal fit for me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just so. Stress spoils the flavor of blood. 
Stay in good health, for my sake. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Why are you standing there dumbfounded. 
Was my trick not up to much?
choice_data_list: No, it was so convincing I got swept up in it...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see. 
...Did you enjoy Halloween, then?

I'd never dreamed she would be the one 
playing the trick. All of it was unexpected, 
and I told her that was exactly what made it fun.
choice_data_list: Thanks for setting up a trick for me!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Heh. To be thanked for playing a trick. 
But... I see how it is.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Tricks are the heart of Halloween... 
I feel I understand that now myself.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. 
Don't let your guard down next year either.
